question: What capacity per gram of sulfur did the cathode deliver at cycle 1500 at 1C, and what share is that of the reversible capacity it showed at 1C in the rate test?
rendered:
The capacity per gram of sulfur delivered at cycle 1500 at 1C is 306 mAh/g (as mentioned in the result section on page 5).

The reversible capacity at 1C in the rate test is 370 mAh/gS (as mentioned in the result section on page 5). 

To find the share of the capacity delivered at cycle 1500 of the reversible capacity at 1C, we can divide the capacity delivered at cycle 1500 by the reversible capacity at 1C:

306 mAh/g ÷ 370 mAh/gS ≈ 0.827 or approximately 83%
